warnings.message: 'Claim Analysis Job' creates a new httpHeaderAuth credential. Set genericAuthType to 'httpTemplatedCustomAuth' instead — `Authorization: Bearer <token>` becomes the template {"headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer {{api_key}}"}} — or credential setup will reject it. Plain generic types are only for reusing an existing credential.
